name: Kaneyama (Yamagata, Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Kaneyama town emblem in white: a stylised letter M with rounded peaks, like twin mountains.
history: Municipal flag of Kaneyama, a town in Yamagata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 10 June 1972.

features.role: Kaneyama town emblem — a stylised letter M with rounded peaks, like twin mountains
